claim_text: Reduce emissions intensity by 40% by 2025 and deliver 50% intensity reduction by 2030.
metric_name: Shipping emissions intensity improvement against IMO 2008 baseline
context_text: Reduce emissions intensity by 40% by 2025 and deliver 50% intensity reduction by 2030.；Against the IMO’s 2008 baseline year for emissions intensity, our 2025 performance showed a 39% improvement. This result falls 1% short of our ambition to deliver a 40% reduction by 2025, largely due to weather impacts in the Pilbara region.
label: Suspected Greenwash
rationale_short: 2025实际改善为39%，低于40%的2025目标，与claim不符。
notes: claim 为目标型表述，实际结果差1个百分点。
llm_reason: The claim’s decisive assertion is that emissions intensity will be reduced by 40% by 2025 and by 50% by 2030 (i.e., specific, time-bound reduction targets). No evidence was provided to substantiate that these targets exist, what baseline and scope the “intensity” refers to, or any progress/results toward 2025 or 2030. Because there is no substantive factual support in the provided evidence fields for either the 40% or 50% reduction targets, the claim is not verified as written.
